sources.title: GlobMP: Continuous-Time Constrained Motion Planning
sources.snippet: GlobMP represents each motion as a piecewise polynomial, so every constraint, whether an obstacle, a separation between robots, or closeness to a learned policy's proposal, becomes a polynomial that must stay nonnegative over the whole motion, not only at sampled times.

sources.title: Continuous-Time Motion Planningand Steering with Global Convergence
sources.snippet: We propose GlobMP (Global Motion Planning), a gradient projection method over piecewise-polynomial curves, on which each constraint is one polynomial per piece that must stay nonnegative over the whole motion; it alternates cost reduction with feasibility restoration.
